title: Asked my crush out with an agenda.
caption: Capricorn asked their crush out with an agenda and a confirm-by-EOD. Clear plans are a kindness. Keep the plan, add why you want to go: Saturday sounds better with a little heart in it. Send this to the friend who texts like a calendar invite.
